dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous linear narrowing from the broad mid-section toward a pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and free of localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey baseline throughout the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, low-frequency diffuse dark-grey mottling across the mid-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and low-contrast gradients between varying shades of grey.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single dark, circular point mark located on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal shadow along the right-hand margin indicative of a raised dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Isolated small dark point/lesion on the posterior dorsal surface.
